children: The GRVT supply unlock is scheduled for 29 Jul 2027 and will release about 61.32 million GRVT, equal to 16.85% of the circulating supply. The release covers allocations for the airdrop, the ecosystem, investors and the team.
The airdrop accounts for most of the release. As those tokens become available to recipients, they will add substantially to the amount of GRVT that could be sold.

title: GRVT Token: Supply Unlock Releases About 61.32 Million GRVT - 29 Jul 2027
